description: Hold a deal for this scout for 72 hours so no other scout replies to the same founder. Free. Call it when the user decides to reply, BEFORE they post. Returns the post link, the drafted opener and the scout's links. The user posts the reply from their OWN X account (you never post), then you call report_deal_progress with stage 'sent' and the reply URL. Claiming again refreshes the hold. 409 claimed_by_another_scout = someone else holds it; pick another deal.
name: claim_deal
title: Claim a scout deal
